skills.super-board: Orchestrator: plans waves, runs Build → QA → Review, merges when green.
skills.super-collect: Finds problems, verifies them, writes a findings doc for /to-spec and /to-tickets.
skills.git-sync: Commit per logical change, merge-pull, push without force, report.
skills.north-star: One short interview that fixes an app's why, must-haves and destination.

skills.super-build: Builder lane: worktree, smallest safe change, tests, draft PR.
skills.super-qa: Tester lane: evidence, test-gap check, screenshots, or bounce to Build.
skills.super-review: Reviewer lane: own hypotheses, remembers prior findings, merge gate.
skills.pr-security-review: Security pass on red and boundary amber cards; super-qa runs it, findings fail QA.

standalone.title: Kept here, not installed into apps — 2 skills

skills.ui-refine-loop: Critique → refine loop that polishes one page or component.
skills.visual: One HTML page: branch recap, plan, or codebase map with diagrams.

helpers.title: Helpers installed beside the pack — 18 skills

skills.tdd: Build lane: every change goes red, green, refactor.
skills.diagnosing-bugs: Build lane on bug cards: reproduce and pin the cause first.
skills.code-review: QA and Review lanes: standards and spec review of a diff.
skills.codebase-design: Review lane and refactors: deep-module design vocabulary.
skills.domain-modeling: Build lane when a card touches domain terms, glossary or ADRs.
skills.verification-before-completion: Every lane: run the checks before claiming done.
skills.prototype: Throwaway prototype that settles a design question before a ticket.
skills.to-spec: Turns a findings doc or idea into a spec; super-collect hands off here.
skills.to-tickets: Splits a spec into board tickets with acceptance criteria.
skills.grilling: Stress-tests a plan with hard questions before it becomes tickets.
skills.research: Primary-source research written up as a Markdown file in the repo.
skills.triage: Sorts incoming issues into actionable, duplicate or won't-fix.
skills.handoff: Writes a handoff note so the next session picks up cleanly.
skills.claude-handoff: Hands the current task to a fresh Claude session.
skills.to-questionnaire: Turns open questions into a questionnaire the owner answers.
skills.wizard: Interactive bash wizard for steps only the owner can do.
skills.retro: Run retro: what worked, what broke, what to change next.

retired.title: Retired — pruned from apps on install
retired.user_wide: npx skills add -g mattpocock/skills --skill setup-matt-pocock-skills --skill setup-ts-deep-modules --skill setup-pre-commit --skill git-guardrails-claude-code; npx skills add -g ozbg/funl-factory --skill visual

names.ui-refine-loop: kept in the factory repo for standalone use
names.visual: kept in the factory repo; install it user-wide
names.security-audit: pr-security-review covers PRs; no lane runs it
names.implement-spec: super-collect files tickets on the board Backlog
names.writing-for-agents: for authoring skills; the factory repo has it, apps do not
names.git-guardrails-claude-code: the guard hooks cover it; install it user-wide
